## PR description
### docs(recipe): fix MiniCPM-o 4.5 curl TTS example and clarify chat_template_kwargs usage  [labels: ready]
##Summary
Fixes incorrect TTS invocation guidance in the MiniCPM-o 4.5 recipe. The curl smoke test previously nested chat_template_kwargs under extra_body, which is not merged into the request root for raw HTTP calls. As a result, use_tts_template never reached the chat template, <|tts_bos|> was missing from the prompt, and Stage-1 talker returned silent WAV instead of speech.

##Changes
Update the curl example to pass chat_template_kwargs at the request root
Document that the OpenAI Python SDK may still use extra_body, because the client flattens those fields
Clarify response shape: text and audio typically appear in separate choices entries when modalities: ["text", "audio"]
Correct the TTS trigger note: without use_tts_template, clients still receive an audio field but it is silent (not text-only)
Root cause
Verified via /v1/chat/completions/render:

| Request shape | Prompt ends with <|tts_bos|> (151703) | |---|---| | extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.use_tts_template=true | No | | Top-level chat_template_kwargs.use_tts_template=true | Yes |

Stage-1 llm2tts requires the <|tts_bos|> … <|tts_eos|> span in thinker output to drive MiniCPMTTS + Token2Wav. Without it, talker skips real synthesis.

Test plan
 POST /v1/chat/completions/render with nested extra_body.chat_template_kwargs → no 151703 in token_ids
 POST /v1/chat/completions/render with top-level chat_template_kwargs → token_ids ends with 151703
 POST /v1/chat/completions with corrected curl payload → non-zero audio amplitude (~12s WAV at 24 kHz)
 Compared against broken recipe example → silent audio (max amplitude = 0)
